title: Winter Board Drive 2026
body:
Our Winter Board Drive brought the Toledo skateboarding community together on a cold February afternoon to give back to the youth who need it most. 36 complete setups were distributed, along with warm gear donated by local businesses.

A big thank you to everyone who donated boards, trucks, wheels, and clothing to make this event possible. The response from the community was incredible — we had more donations than we could handle, and the rest will go toward our spring giveaway.

If you want to donate boards, gear, or time for our next drive, reach out to us on the contact page. Every contribution goes directly to Toledo youth.
